After returning home with a Nintendo, Lin Jian Yin inserts the cartridge that the owner sold to him at a huge discount. Only then does he discover that this is actually a simulation game. As I can bring such a prison along with me, whoever dares to provoke me, I will release one of the prisoners out…

One day, Sumeragi Yuuto was suddenly transferred to a new world. This world resembles a world from a novel that Yuuto recently read. It is a world where beauty and ugliness are reversed. 16548.synopsis:

A corrupt monk, a fake Taoist, a carefree prince, a warm-hearted rabbit demon…. Every incident binds the two of them together, unable to unravel the thread.

I, Ookami Yukine, a girl who has been hospitalized for a long time since a child due to severe pain from unknown cause. When I realized, I was already dead. Once she crossed over in a novel, she became the hateful cannon fodder who married the Seventh Lord of Gu family. It’s rumored that the Seventh Lord of Gu family has a Buddha’s mouth but a viper’s heart, unpredictable temperament, and very superb at making a human skin painted fan.

Her rebirth gave her a second chance at life. She was back with a vengeance and wanted to make those that had harmed her pay.

She thought that by getting her revenge for her past life, she would be happy in this life.

“If you want, I’ll take her crown and gladly put it over your head, and lead you to the throne…”
He whispered the devilish sweet words into her ears with a gentle voice. 
“So, what’s your answer?” 
Will I be able to stop the loop and become a real villainess?

32676.synopsis:
Yun An was a volunteer chosen among thousands by the space time research institute. Simply planning to record the true historical events of the military revolt in the year nine hundred and sixty, she signed the consent form, stepped into the time machine, but a peculiar thing happened during her travel through time, causing Yun An to be sent to an unknown place and time…
This dynasty was not recorded in earth’s history; perhaps Yun An had entered a parallel world.
This kingdom was known as the ‘Yan’ kingdom. It’s regime was similar to the middle period of the Ming dynasty. The economy was an unprecedented level of prosperity, and the men were regarded as superior to women.
The renowned Lin family of the Yan kingdom lived in luxury and extravagance. Their extreme wealth had already continued for three generations.
However, the famous Lin family faced an awkward problem at their third generation— the master of the family had no son.
Although the master of the Lin family had seven concubines, he had not gained a son for years. Master Lin eventually became too old to have any hope for a male heir.
The rise and fall of the Lin family now rests on the shoulders of master Lin’s only legitimate daughter: Lin Buxian.
The Lin family appeared to be powerful and untouchable, but it was actually surrounded with danger.
Their wealth was hankered after by powerful ministers and coveted by their relatives. Lin Buxian was a woman, but she had to step out often. Because of this, she was often denounced by the public. Eight merchants came to attend Lin Buxian’s twentieth birthday, but they heard the shocking news that her past childhood friend had already become the lucky son-in-law of a Minister, and he intended to take her as a concubine?
Lin Buxian made an announcement to the entire kingdom during her birthday banquet; the Lin estate is looking for a handsome son-in-law, to marry and live with the bride’s family.

35492.synopsis:
Lu Qipei has died at the hands of the person she trusted most.
However, what she regretted most before she died was that she had appeared before Princess Qi Yang and had an out-of-norm (l**bian) marriage with her. After dying, she would still be pulling Princess Qi Yang into a quagmire.

Yet, Princess Qi Yang had been reborn as well and even managed to successfully capture this wild, escaped prince consort on the first day of being reborn…
Qi Yang (smiling): You still want to run? Servants, come and bring this prince consort back!
Lu Qipei (tightly covering her clothes): No no no, who are you? You’re not that cute and innocent little princess of mine!

36004.synopsis:

After jumping from her apartment, she was reborn…
During this particular lifetime, she swore she won’t attack others unless she was attacked. If she was attacked, she must remove out the source of trouble…
So she started a perfect plan to revenge them. However, she became the prey of a man…

37284.synopsis:
Harrieta, the eldest daughter of a Viscount from the countryside, has a crush on Edwin, the heir to the most influential and wealthiest family in the kingdom.
She knew it was a futile dream, so she didn’t say a word to him.
And then the news of his engagement came suddenly. 
When Harrieta, who had been suffering from a broken heart, finally began to recover, she heard,

Edwin bowed his head and kissed carefully on the back of her hand. His breath that brushed her hand, was hot.

39844.synopsis:
Li Mo, a senior beautician from the modern era, transmigrated to the ancient period and became a peasant woman sold to a countryside man. 
Looking at the crumbling thatched house, a husband with a disabled leg, and the bony little bun, Li Mo sighed and realized she must make a fortune.

43684.synopsis:
Yun Ruoyue (30), a general surgeon from the 21st century who died from a car accident and her soul transmigrated back to 1800 years ago in ancient China. Her soul occupied another body with a new entity as Princess Consort Li. 
She is beautiful, kind-hearted and with inborn courageous. She fights for what she believes in and never afraid to stand up for injustice. 
This novel follows the turbulent growth of her in adjusting in her new life and how she fight back including her prince husband, Chu Xuanchen, to take back her rightful place. 
Chu Xuanchen (23), a prince from the Great Chu dynasty, he is handsome and intelligent, arrogant and domineering, and his biggest weakness that he’s a man of word, just like a typical military man. 
He was forced by the Emperor to marry Yun Rouyue as his princess consort, the daughter of the enemy who killed his parents. In the end, he did marry her even though he didn’t love her. After the marriage, he treated her badly and even marries another woman of his love in order to degrade and humiliate Yun Rouyue. 
At first, he thought that he would be happy after married the woman of his love, Nangong Rou, but he was wrong. Later on, and slowly, he realised the person in his heart was actually Yun Rouyue and has no love feeling to Nangong Rou other than just gratitude because she saved his life two years ago.
Apparently, he was too late as Yun Rouyue didn’t love him and wanted a divorce, and the story goes on with how he will woo her back and they stay happily ever after.

43940.synopsis:

47012.synopsis:

This small nation should have been easily defeated but it is still holding out after seven long, arduous years. The reason comes down to one person, the unknown assassin. As the First Prince of Ibeden closes in on the Kemened Kingdom, his subordinate Count Custer is killed in a brothel. His burned out eyes, like bloody moons, leave no doubt as to identity of person who killed him. Yet again it was the unknown assassin.

48036.synopsis:
Upon reincarnating in a world where chaos was rampant, Shen Changqing became a member of the Great Qin Demon Suppression Division. Kill monsters and upgrade [Thirteen Cross Practice] to perfection! Kill powerful demons and break the limits of Martial Arts! KILL ––

49060.synopsis:

Knowing from the start that he was never a man she could dare to reach for, Sehee proposed a relationship with a set ending— and Taewook, unwilling to let Secretary Yoon Sehee slip away, accepted.

129956.synopsis:
Ning Zhou regarded being the main setter of Team China as his lifelong pursuit. Yet until the day he retired, he was nothing more than a dispensable substitute.
During the painful days of injury and frustration, he finally came to terms with it:
No one can take your place when you work yourself into illness — true meaning of life is to chill.
Isn’t happy volleyball much sweeter?
When he opened his eyes again, Ning Zhou had returned to his 20-year-old self, his body in perfect condition, right at the turning point of his athletic career…
Ning Zhou: I’m done grinding. Whatever happens, happens!
A young substitute setter joins Team China.
Teammates whisper: “A setter who’s only 1.78m tall? What’s the point of sending him in?”
But after spiking off Ning Zhou’s perfect set, everyone scrambles: “Zhou Zhou, please! Set for me again!”
Later, the substitute setter joins a sports variety show—and blows up in popularity.
Teammates practically want to worship him: “So many sponsors followed Zhou Zhou here. Genius!”
Ning Zhou: ?… I only came because I heard there was money…
Later still, in an international match, Ning Zhou is sent on in a desperate situation with the team trailing by a wide margin. With maxed-out game sense, he outsmarts the opposing blockers and has them running in circles.
Fans and coaches alike are stunned speechless.
But Ning Zhou has no time to celebrate—because the team’s star outside hitter, the man leading the “superhumanization of men’s volleyball” with his thunderous spikes, is tugging at him, sulking:
“Why did you set less to me than to the opposite? Zhou Zhou, am I not the attacker you trust most anymore?”

136356.synopsis:
Oh Yujin had always dreamed of a normal life: getting married, having two kids, and building a happy family.
But on the day he was dumped by the woman he had been dating with marriage in mind, he went to a bar out of frustration and ended up kissing a complete stranger.
Having grown up in a conservative household with devout parents, he had never once doubted his own sexuality. And yet, the man he had shared that intoxicating kiss with kept flashing before his eyes.
A recent breakup, constant pressure from his parents, an exhausting job… and now, to make matters worse, stress-induced erectile dysfunction?
Nothing in his life had ever gone right!
After much hesitation, Yujin finally decided to visit a urologist.
But for some reason, the doctor’s smiling eyes above his mask looked strangely familiar.
“Patient, please lower your pants and lie down.”
“Excuse me, doctor. You know me, don’t you?”
Yujin had always followed a clear blueprint for his life. Oh Yujin, the young traditionalist who always lived within the mold set for him. Oh Yujin, the pushover who didn’t even know what he truly wanted.
But can Oh Yujin find happiness with Ji Haewon—a man who is the complete opposite of everything he ever dreamed of?

142244.synopsis:
Jiang Fuyi was born through transmigration, birthed from a clam shell, and then imprisoned deep underwater with her mother.
Her mother had been imprisoned for an unknown number of years and was quite insane.
One day, she suddenly became lucid for a moment and told Fuyi: “Our species, you see, our hearts can be used to forge powerful swords, and they can regenerate. Your father passed by this sea years ago. I saw that he had extraordinary bone structure and would surely achieve greatness someday, so I took pains to capture him, carved out my heart, forged a sword, and gifted it to him. I hoped he would master his skills and return soon to save me from the sea.”
“Although I’ve forgotten who he is, I sense that he has been a Supreme Being for many years. Go out and ask him why he hasn’t returned to save me yet.”
Jiang Fuyi: “How should I make myself known to my father?”
Mother: “Mother and daughter are connected by heart. The sword in his hand is my heart. As long as you appear near him, he will recognize you.”
Jiang Fuyi was sent ashore by her mother. After enduring countless hardships, she finally arrived in the cultivation world.
However…
What’s with all these immortal and demonic bigshots who suddenly pop up, revealing “maternal love” towards her?
Jiang Fuyi: My mom really knows how to invest!
…
The unfortunate thing is that all these bigshots have forgotten the origin of the sword in their hands, including her biological father.
It wasn’t until Jiang Fuyi herself carved out her heart to forge a sword that she finally realized the side effect of heart regeneration in their species.
After every regeneration, a portion of memory is lost.
And a mutual forgetting occurs between the Stonesoul and the person who received the sword.
…
Male Lead (Yan Lan): It was a good thing they forgot. That’s how I got my chance.
Reading Guide:
Slightly leaning towards an ensemble cast, not a typical “Great Female Protagonist” (Dà Nǚzhǔ) power fantasy. No ab*se of the female lead. It’s a slow-paced growth story. The male lead is generally unexciting and quiet, serves as the caretaker, the money bag, and is mainly focused on companionship.
The main focus is on the plot. The plot has moments of humor and moments of heartbreak. We can only guarantee a Happy Ending (HE) for the male and female leads.
Regarding the female lead’s species: This species are born master sword-smiths. Their heart is a regenerative sword stone. The species has both males and females. They feel no pain when extracting a sword stone. The swords they forge can be given to anyone and are used for various purposes (swords forged with the heart/sword stone can control sword puppets, and Stonesouls are very, very, very powerful).
The female lead’s mother successfully invested in five swords. Swords without an owner or those given as tokens of friendship are not counted.
Regarding the female lead’s transmigration: This setting only serves to explain that she has a basic worldview after coming ashore from the sea. Since she was gestating in the egg/shell for too long, she has essentially forgotten her past life and is no different from a native inhabitant.
